# Book I Definition 23: two proper coplanar lines have
# parallel directions and a nonzero transverse separation.
# The two equivalence directions below certify the source nonintersection definition.
release obj def geometry::main::vec
release obj def geometry::main::det

prop are_parallel_lines(a, b, c, d cart(R, R)):
    a != b
    c != d
    $geometry::main::is_parallel(a, b, c, d)
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c)) != 0

# Book I, Postulate 4 interpreted as a theorem of the real-plane model.
# Source definition 10's equal-adjacent-angle bridge remains a separate item.
thm postulate_4_model:
    ? forall p, q, r, u, v, w cart(R, R):
        $geometry::main::is_right_angle(p, q, r)
        $geometry::main::is_right_angle(u, v, w)
        =>:
            $geometry::main::are_angles_congruent(p, q, r, u, v, w)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(q, p)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(q, r)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(v, u)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(v, w)
    geometry::main::distance_sq(q, p) $in R+
    geometry::main::distance_sq(q, r) $in R+
    geometry::main::distance_sq(v, u) $in R+
    geometry::main::distance_sq(v, w) $in R+
    geometry::main::distance_sq(q, p) * geometry::main::distance_sq(q, r) $in R+
    geometry::main::distance_sq(v, u) * geometry::main::distance_sq(v, w) $in R+
    geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, r) = geometry::main::distance_sq(q, p) * geometry::main::distance_sq(q, r) > 0
    geometry::main::angle_cos_den(u, v, w) = geometry::main::distance_sq(v, u) * geometry::main::distance_sq(v, w) > 0
    geometry::main::angle_cos_num(p, q, r) = geometry::main::dot(geometry::main::vec(q, p), geometry::main::vec(q, r)) = 0
    geometry::main::angle_cos_num(u, v, w) = geometry::main::dot(geometry::main::vec(v, u), geometry::main::vec(v, w)) = 0
    geometry::main::angle_cos_num(p, q, r)^2 * geometry::main::angle_cos_den(u, v, w) = 0^2 * geometry::main::angle_cos_den(u, v, w) = 0 = 0^2 * geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, r) = geometry::main::angle_cos_num(u, v, w)^2 * geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, r)
    geometry::main::angle_cos_num(p, q, r) * geometry::main::angle_cos_num(u, v, w) = 0 * 0 = 0 >= 0
    by def $geometry::main::are_angles_congruent(p, q, r, u, v, w)
